title: Delay Information in Virtual Queues: A Large-Scale Field Experiment on a Major Ride-Sharing Platform
authors: Qiuping Yu; Yiming Zhang; Yong‐Pin Zhou
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment on ride-level wait-time information (neutral/optimistic/pessimistic), analysed with Weibull survival models with gamma frailty on matched samples (Table 3). No staggered adoption or TWFE DiD.
design_notes: Table3/table3_basemodel_matchedhighctrl.do: streg ib1.total_EWT_neu_min 1.t_high#i.initial_congestion_level quoted_price trip_distance i.date_type i.peak_type i.queue_id, d(weibull) frailty(gamma) shared(passenger_id).
data_files_note: Code imports experiment_data_aftercleaning.csv, which is not shipped; package contains only code, logs and result CSVs.
software_notes: Stata (streg) for Table 3; R for figures.
screener_notes: Published PDF text read; RCT. Out of scope.
